_comment: In-app purchases (docs/PURCHASES.md): Play Console product ids and what each gives. Prices live in Play Console (suggested: gems_small and starter_pack at the lowest tier, Rs 89 / $0.99; gems_medium Rs 449 / $4.99; gems_large Rs 899 / $9.99); the game shows Play's own price text. Bigger packs give more gems per rupee (+20%, +30%), the studio norm. The starter pack is one-time and worth several times its price (the norm for a first purchase).
